test_cases.description: Power up a main node with N sub nodes; run discovery; verify all N sub nodes are enumerated in order with node addresses 0..N-1 and that phantom power is switched segment-by-segment.
Verify exactly one superframe is transmitted per audio sample period and that it contains a SYNC/control region, a downstream portion, and an upstream portion.
Inject a known sample at the main node's local I2S input and verify it appears at the farthest sub node's local I2S output with deterministic latency of about two samples.
Map a downstream audio slot to a sub node and verify the correct channel is delivered to that node's local I2S/TDM output.
Map an upstream audio slot from a sub node (e.g. a microphone) and verify it arrives sample-aligned at the main node.
From the host, read/write a sub node transceiver register and a sub-node-local I2C peripheral over the tunneled I2C path; verify correct access.
Toggle a sub node GPIO input and verify the state is reproduced at the main node (GPIO over distance).
Verify a bus-powered sub node operates with no local supply, drawing power from the line.
Inject cable open / short-to-ground / short-to-battery / short-across-pair / reversed-wiring on a segment and verify the fault is detected, localized, and reported upstream via interrupt status.
Force loss of bus lock at a mid-chain node and verify the downstream chain breaks and the event is reported upstream to the main node.

bring_up_sequence.description: PHANTOM POWER (BUS POWER) OVER THE TWISTED PAIR
TUNNELED I2S / TDM AUDIO, I2C CONTROL, GPIO, AND INTERRUPTS
I2S / TDM audio tunneling: each A2B transceiver has a local I2S/TDM port

derived_compliance_test_categories: Register access (read/write to all fields; reserved-bit behavior).
